How do I use it properly the very first time?
Message from IPSY Glam Bot:
Here’s a smooth “first time” way to use IPSY: 
Join + set up your Beauty Profile: Visit IPSY.com, click Get Started, and complete the Beauty Quiz (you can update it anytime).
Pick your plan: Choose IPSY Original, IPSY Extra, or IPSY Ultimate, then enter your billing and shipping info.
Right after you join: You’re charged immediately and sent the most recently released bag.
Use Choice when it opens:
IPSY Original: you can choose 1 product for your next bag (usually mid-month).
IPSY Extra: you choose 3 products from 12 PM PT on the 1st through 3 PM PT on the 3rd.
IPSY Ultimate: you choose 3 products from 12 PM PT on the 1st through 3 PM PT on the 3rd of upgrade months (February, May, August, and November).
Shop Add-Ons (optional): Starting at 11:59 PM PT on the 1st of each month, you can choose up to 10 Add-Ons (starting at $3.50) and they ship free with your order.
Review what you receive: You can start reviewing your current month’s products around the third week of every month, and you can review products up to five months back.
One quick heads-up: if you joined around the 20th of the month, your first month can be a little different—you may not be able to access Add-Ons or Choice for the current month, but you’ll unlock the full experience starting the next month.
